stories.title: RBI eases forex reporting rules for service exports and imports
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India on Tuesday announced that, effective 1 October 2026, foreign‑exchange reporting requirements for service‑related exports and imports are being relaxed. Transactions up to Rs 10 lakh are exempt from filing a separate Export Declaration Form, and for resident individuals the form is deemed submitted once the authorised dealer bank receives the payment‑credit information, with no value threshold for them.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: Anthropic is still grappling with the economics of compute
stories.summary: In particular, the company is finally disclosing more about the economics of compute, and how much of Anthropic’s skyrocketing revenue is being lost to compute costs. Broadly, Anthropic had a good quarter: revenue reached $17 billion, up from $11.5 billion in the previous quarter, suggesting durable growth.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.

stories.title: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank posts Rs 70 crore loss in Q2, sixth straight quarterly loss
stories.summary: The bank recorded a net loss of Rs 70 crore in the second quarter, marking its sixth consecutive quarterly loss. Operating profit was Rs 85 crore, but provisions of Rs 166 crore resulted in the net loss. The gross non‑performing asset ratio eased to 5.96% and the loan book grew 7.5% year‑on‑year to Rs 20,062 crore.
stories.why: Ongoing losses raise concerns about profitability and capital adequacy, which matter to investors and borrowers.

stories.title: RBI launches three surveys on inflation expectations and consumer confidence ahead of December meeting
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced the launch of three separate surveys designed to gather information on consumers' expectations about future price movements and their overall confidence in the economy. The surveys are being rolled out ahead of the RBI's policy meeting scheduled for December, providing fresh data for the central bank's considerations.

stories.title: High Court hears challenge to Australia’s child social media ban
stories.summary: Reddit and a digital‑rights group argued before the High Court that the social‑media ban for children, introduced in December, is unconstitutional and infringes free‑communication rights. The hearing follows a change in the plaintiff lineup, with teen Noah Jones no longer a plaintiff but attending. The ban is part of the government’s broader online‑safety reforms.
stories.why: The decision will decide if the ban stays in force, shaping Australia’s future approach to protecting minors online.
